messages.subject: prob gradient testing w. finite diffs
parts:
I mentioned that Daniel was testing gradients of log
probs and Matt mentioned that he'd written some
finite difference code to test gradients in the base
model class:

stan/mcmc/prob_grad.hpp

You could use this as well to test the distribution
gradients.

It should probably be moved out of prob_grad itself, but
it's nice having it in there as it'll work on complete
models and can bring in the virtual methods for log_prob()
and grad_log_prob() to test.

- Bob
